maria: Quick check-in  need final social copy + assets for the webinar 'Serving Inference Economics'. Deliverables: X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn post, hero image, 15s clip, UTMs. Deadline: tomorrow noon PST.
linda: I can run the X thread and schedule. Propose 2 openers for A/B test: A) 'Cut inference costs 3x' B) 'Same model, half the infra bill'. Which lands?
josh: Draft thread in doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Paste opener variants below. Also added LinkedIn caption and suggested CTA: "Register now".
priya: UTM plan: utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=serving_inference_q2, utm_term={startup|enterprise}. Will create landing variants /webinar/serving?variant=startup|enterprise.
sam (SDR): HubSpot list = webinar_serving_inference. Route to SDR - Growth queue round-robin. Spike rule: if title includes "VP|Director|Head" tag as high-intent and notify kevin. Follow-up templates ready.
linda: Need hero PNG (1200x627) + 15s MP4. Leo can deliver if I give script. Maria, can you share slide title?
maria: Slide title: "Serving LLMs: cost-first playbook". Use that for hero. Approvals: josh final copy by 10am, design by 11am, priya UTMs by 11:30, sam SDR check by noon.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer (pending approval).
maria: Thanks team  ping here when each item is done.
